title: “Pakeezah”
text: In 1972 “Pakeezah”, which had taken Kamal Amrohi some fourteen years to finish, was released. Meena Kumari died a few weeks later.

title: The Bajaj Chetak
text: From 1972 the Bajaj Chetak scooter carried whole families. In some years people waited a very long time for theirs to be delivered.
